rationale: Accepted by the independent requirements review at document cycle 6 (author claude-opus-5-5, reviewer codex gpt-6.1-sol; no blocking finding). INPUT-2 supersedes INPUT-1 after implementation admission 1, whose candidate passed SRR-C02 and SRR-C03 and failed only SRR-C01's retention oracle on a doctest named by its source line (D-SRR-DOCTEST-IDENTITY-1, operator A: compare without the line suffix, collision-checked) and fell short of SRR-C04(6) test coverage (F-SRR-IMPL-02: two more daemon tests, orient on both routes, the exact reason and the reader-facing line, a root removed after registration). The valid-root seed hand-off is observed through a test-only hook owned by the seed call site before any model load (D-SRR-SEED-OBSERVABLE-1, operator A, with Correction 1). Cycles 4-5 were operator-text corrections; cycle 6 accepted. The author's low note F-PREP-07 (the hook is inert unless a test installs it) is carried as an implementation obligation in the admission-2 packet. Decisions: D-SRR-ROOTPATH-1 (human, A, operator Correction 1), D-SRR-SCOPE-1, D-SRR-DOCTEST-IDENTITY-1, D-SRR-SEED-OBSERVABLE-1 (operator, overridable by the human).
